name: HyTAS
description: Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) plays an increasingly critical role in precise vision tasks within remote sensing, capturing a wide spectrum of visual data. Transformer architectures have significantly enhanced HSI task performance, while advancements in Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) have improved model discovery. To harness these advancements for HSI classification, we make the following contributions: i) We propose HyTAS, the first benchmark on transformer architecture search for Hyperspectral imaging, ii) We comprehensively evaluate 12 different methods to identify the optimal transformer over 5 different datasets, iii) We perform an extensive factor analysis on the Hyperspectral transformer search performance, greatly motivating future research in this direction. All benchmark materials are available at HyTAS.
reputation: A new, specialized benchmark for transformer architecture search in hyperspectral imaging with early adoption by researchers in HSI and NAS communities.
notes: Domain‑specific (hyperspectral) datasets are often small and dataset characteristics vary widely; architecture search is compute‑intensive; results can be sensitive to dataset splits and preprocessing, so cross‑dataset comparability is limited.
